scope: v2: recommendation consistency + tone + sample-vs-total + hedged-vs-asserted

findings.message: The Executive Summary and all Findings priorities use first-person voice ('We audited', 'We identified', 'We measured', 'We confirmed'), but the Optional Enhancements sub-section switches to impersonal third-person constructions without a first-person subject, creating a voice inconsistency within the Findings section.
findings.context: adding `sameAs` links pointing to stable external identifiers on the existing Person (29) and Organization (30) entities gives machines an unambiguous anchor

findings.message: The Optional Enhancements item on AggregateRating states 'the audited pages already carry Review (4) entries alongside Book (26) and Product (12) types', then recommends surfacing an AggregateRating rollup on 'those entities' — implying the recommendation applies to Book and Product entities site-wide, when the evidence base is only the 95 audited pages.
findings.context: the audited pages already carry Review (4) entries alongside Book (26) and Product (12) types, so surfacing an `AggregateRating` rollup on those entities
